first_angle.prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Paint the LARGE construction drawing on the RIGHT of this image as a finished overhead tactical-game factory sprite. The small building on the LEFT is ONLY the material/paint reference; omit it from the output. KEEP THE LARGE DRAWING'S EXACT SHALLOW DIAGONAL, FOUR RECTANGULAR ROOF BAYS, SLIM OUTLINE, HIGH OVERHEAD PROJECTION AND VERY THIN WALL DEPTH. Do not rotate it, tilt it toward the camera, widen it or substitute a generic isometric view. Its main centerline rises TWO units for THREE units horizontally, from bottom left to top right. Keep the four grey roof planes in their existing corner positions; apply detailed slate tile texture and crisp roof trim to them. The blue glazing is ONLY a thin steep face BETWEEN roof planes, never an exterior glass wall along the side. Pale stone eaves, thin masonry strips, one small upright round chimney at the upper right. Camera nearly overhead, looking almost straight down, so roofs dominate and walls are only a few pixels deep. Vertical chimney stands screen-up. Fixed upper-left lighting. The finished sprite must read as the exact same four-bay factory as the small reference, with its geometry seen from the large drawing's fixed high camera. Return ONE complete isolated building, in a LANDSCAPE 1536 by 1024 image with generous margins and ALPHA transparency. Remove background, hexes, dots and small reference. No text, glow, shadows, ground, additional building or objects.
